_README: EXAMPLE ONLY — least-privilege template. The ACTIVE policy lives OUTSIDE Git (e.g. ~/.config/chatgpt-cloud-elixir/local-control/policy.json). Copy this file, replace every REPLACE_WITH_* placeholder, then run: scripts/local_control_agent.py validate-policy --policy <path>. WARNING: an empty or missing allowed_operations list falls back to the agent's FULL default operation set — always list operations explicitly. An empty write_roots list denies ALL writes.
